command: gtk=$(cat -- "$1") || exit 1; data=${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}; found() { [ -d "$data/themes/$1" ] || [ -d "$HOME/.themes/$1" ] && return 0; ( IFS=:; for d in ${XDG_DATA_DIRS:-/usr/local/share:/usr/share}; do [ -d "$d/themes/$1" ] && exit 0; done; exit 1 ); }; for dir in "$2"/*/; do [ -d "$dir" ] || continue; dir=${dir%/}; at="$data/themes/${dir##*/}"; [ -e "$at" ] || found "${dir##*/}" || { mkdir -p -- "${at%/*}" && ln -sfn -- "$dir" "$at"; } || exit 1; done; [ "$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme)" = "'$gtk'" ] && exit 0; exec gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface gtk-theme "$gtk"
